info.name: FastNEAR accounts Broadcast Tx Commit API

description.content: Low-latency indexed account, token, and public-key lookup APIs for wallets and explorers. Embedded portal clients may forward an optional `apiKey` query parameter, but the public FastNEAR API does not require it.
